name: Manhunt Files
structure: cold open: the capture moment + 'This is <name>. For <N> days he is the most wanted man in <place>'
open loop: the small detail that finally gives him away
capture as the last scene + one-line aftermath + one CTA
title_formula: How The FBI Finally Caught <name/alias> | The <N>-Day Manhunt For <...> | How One <detail> Ended A <N>-Year Manhunt

thumb.style: real PD/federal frame or wanted-poster face inside REC camcorder viewfinder overlay, red DAY counter badge + map pin, max 2 words, bright, no gore

sources_first: FBI.gov / FBI Vault / USMS / ATF videos + photos (US federal public domain)
archive.org PD newsreels for historic manhunts
own dark pursuit map with route line + day counter
official agency bodycam releases (max ~20%, Last Clue list)
